title: App tool result
description: A tool's answer in MCP's tool-result shape. `isError` is true when the tool threw: `content` then holds its message for the panel to show.

content.description: The answer as text: the tool's object as JSON, the text it returned, or the message of the error it threw.

structuredContent.description: The object the tool returned, checked against its `outputSchema` when it has one. Left out when it returned text or threw.
